# DeFi lending protocols gain $2.3B in TVL, fueling token outperformance

[Featured](/news/tag/featured)[DeFi](/news/tag/defi)[Lending](/news/tag/lending)

Apr 23, 2025

2min read

byGino Matos

forCryptoSlate

On-chain lending protocols added $2.3 billion in value locked (TVL) over the past 24 hours, followed by a roughly $700 million increase in active loans and an average 7.7% price increase for lending-related tokens during the same period.

Decentralized lending protocols saw their TVL rise from $40.36 billion to $42.69 billion amid the market rally over the past day, according to DefiLlama **[data](https://defillama.com/protocols/lending)**. This movement corresponds to a daily increase of approximately 6%.

Simultaneously, active loans jumped from $16.4 billion to $17.1 billion between April 21 and April 22, based on Token Terminal **[data](https://tokenterminal.com/explorer?v=NjA3NjgxMWFjZWMxOWRkNTNiOWE2MDQ1)**.

Aave saw the most new loans, registering a $562 million increase in active debt and surpassing $11 billion. Interestingly, Aave’s revenue did not mirror the increase in loans, falling from $418,000 to $67,430 as of press time.

Among the top 10 lending protocols, Euler was the runner-up in terms of daily increase in active loans, with users borrowing almost $30 million over the past 24 hours.

Fluid and [Compound](https://cryptoslate.com/companies/compound/) also saw two-digit loan increases, with daily growths of $14 million and $13 million, respectively.

## **Lending tokens surge**

The growing metrics for on-chain lending protocols were reflected in token prices, as this category registered a 7.7% average gain in the past 24 hours, according to [CoinGecko](https://cryptoslate.com/companies/coingecko/). This is the fifth-best-performing crypto sector out of 22.

According to **[Artemis data](https://app.artemis.xyz/home)**, the daily average performance of lending-related tokens also outperformed the market’s average increase of 5.4%.

*CryptoSlate* data show that Maple Finance’s [SYRUP](https://cryptoslate.com/coins/maple-finance/) led among tokens with a market cap of over $100 million, with a 15.2% increase. This is roughly twice the average performance of lending-related tokens.

Euler ([EUL](https://cryptoslate.com/coins/euler/)) also registered a two-digit price increase, with gains of 11.6% over the past 24 hours. [AAVE](https://cryptoslate.com/coins/aave/) climbed 8,2%, while [MORPHO](https://cryptoslate.com/coins/morpho/) registered a positive 7.2% performance.
